# muxt check reports, in html/template templates, comments and markup
# html/template writes as text a browser shows: a <!-- in <title> or
# <textarea>, a <! that starts no comment or doctype, a <?, and a comment
# a browser ends at <!--> where html/template strips through the next -->.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
! muxt check
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- want-err.txt --
$WORK/template.gohtml:4:18: html/template writes this <!-- as text inside <title>; browsers show it
$WORK/template.gohtml:8:4: html/template escapes this "<!", so browsers show it as text; comment with {{/* */}} or <!-- -->
$WORK/template.gohtml:9:4: html/template escapes this "<?", so browsers show it as text; comment with {{/* */}} or <!-- -->
$WORK/template.gohtml:10:4: browsers end this comment at "<!-->" but html/template strips through the next "-->" at 12:1, hiding the markup between
$WORK/template.gohtml:14:23: html/template writes this <!-- as text inside <textarea>; browsers show it

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><title>Todo<!-- draft --></title></head>
<body>
<!-- {{.}} is stripped, but it still runs -->
<p title="<!-- kept -->">kept</p>
<p><![if !IE]>shown</p>
<p><?php echo 1 ?></p>
<p><!-->hidden
<b>by html/template</b>
-->
<script>/* <!-- passes --> */</script>
<textarea name="note"><!-- shown --></textarea>
</body>
</html>
{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.22
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var formHTML embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(formHTML, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Index() string {
	return "index"
}
